Their two smoothing factors con- tribute decay2j, and each D contributes inverse squared grade. For j ≥4 these are bounded by the uniformly summable decay2. Also U = |m(q0)|2 P a fa + SH is bounded above. Every real summand is nonnegative, and the principal filter and one fa have positive lower bounds. Thus U has an L-independent positive lower bound. The reciprocal estimate bounds U−1 on a narrower collar. These observations bound all factors in the regular correction coefficients of the potential response; every matrix has a fixed face-orientation dimension.
